scope.question: Can Keyspilli turn an arbitrary metal song URL or recording into useful recognizable piano MIDI without user-supplied symbolic material?

notIncluded: automatic recognizable transcription from arbitrary audio

technologyScan.method: official primary pages only via GitHub/arXiv/Jina/web; no model installs or downloads
technologyScan.exa: UNAVAILABLE_LOCAL_NODE_SHIM; not material to the bounded primary-source scan

systems.name: U-MuST
systems.license: MIT code; dataset metadata CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; videos not redistributed
systems.capability: unified score/image/MIDI/audio tokenization with I2A/A2I Transformers
systems.evidence: 1,300+ hours paired YouTube score-image/audio; AMT results reported on MusicNet/MAESTRO
systems.denseMetalEvidence: none demonstrated; focus is Western/classical and piano-heavy

systems.name: TriScore
systems.license: MIT code; source data on request

systems.name: CLaMP3
systems.license: MIT code; checkpoint terms retained in local evidence
systems.capability: cross-modal retrieval with unaligned modality embeddings
systems.denseMetalEvidence: not evaluated because resource bound was hit

systems.name: MuScriptor
systems.license: MIT code; weights CC BY-NC 4.0, non-commercial
systems.capability: multi-instrument audio-to-MIDI; real recordings including heavy metal; velocity not preserved
systems.evidence: 170k real recordings and heavy-metal training claim; official README warns distorted electric-guitar generalization and stem drift can be weak
systems.denseMetalEvidence: training coverage is promising, Keyspilli cold transfer is unmeasured

systems.name: 2025 AMT Challenge
systems.capability: benchmark of current multi-instrument AMT systems
systems.evidence: 8 teams, 2 above MT3; remaining polyphony/timbre issues

technologyScan.resourceDecision: Do not enlarge VPS/runtime bounds or install models in this mission. MuScriptor is the only scan result strong enough to justify a bounded future AMT evaluation, subject to non-commercial rights and cold-transfer evidence.

sourceAvailability.method: deterministic metadata-only sample from the repository's catalog/ug-tabs.json, preserving repo order and excluding the seven protected benchmark songs; no copyrighted bytes downloaded
sourceAvailability.interpretation: 0 structured candidates means none was provenance-safe and machine-readable in this metadata-only scan; it is not proof of absence on the internet.

candidateRankingGap.failurePolicy: withhold when identity, rights, parser, timing or role evidence is insufficient

timingDistribution.scope: observed source-availability evidence, not a universal prevalence estimate

architectureInterpretation.scoreSymbolicRequiresAlignment: not confirmed in either bounded metadata sample
architectureInterpretation.semanticOnly: common lead shape, insufficient timing/rights for generation

alignmentRationale: U-MuST and TriScore are translation/retrieval systems rather than demonstrated continuous timing aligners; CLaMP3 was resource-blocked; existing V2/SKF evidence remains mixed and real independent anchors are absent.
amtRationale: MuScriptor is a materially newer official open-code candidate trained on real recordings including heavy metal, but non-commercial weights, no Keyspilli cold transfer, weak distorted-guitar warning and no velocity mean this is a bounded research evaluation only.

objectiveGates.sourceProvenance: generation class, known rights/provenance, parser valid, not benchmark or diagnostic
objectiveGates.identity: artist/title/version/structure confidence must own the requested region
objectiveGates.timing: native authoritative OR independent alignment pass with at least 3 windows and 32 bars
objectiveGates.region: explicit owner, role confidence and coverage; otherwise withheld
objectiveGates.pipeline: arrangement, six levels, validators, artifacts, player and deterministic bytes
objectiveGates.failure: insufficient evidence is a normal outcome; never publish junk
objectiveGates.determinism: canonical report and artifact hashes repeat

achievableScope: PRIVATE_ALPHA for evidence-augmented metal only after candidate identity, provenance, timing and region gates pass; the full arbitrary-metal URL/audio promise remains research-only.
claimBoundary: Keyspilli can accept a private MIDI, MusicXML or MXL whose symbolic timeline is authoritative, generate validated learner variants, persist them, open the player and export artifacts. It has not established that arbitrary metal URL/audio input becomes useful recognizable piano MIDI without symbolic evidence.
nonClaims: not an arbitrary-song source availability census
